meta_title: Leicester Plumbing & Gas Services | Plumber Leicester
meta_description: Leicester Plumbing and Gas Services: trusted plumbers and Gas Safe engineers in Leicester. Fast response, free quotes, all plumbing and gas work covered. Call today.
hero_eyebrow: Gas Safe Registered — Fast Response Across Leicester
hero_subhead: Leaks, boiler faults, or gas worries can't wait — we're on hand to fix it right, first time.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Gas Services Across Leicester
services_subhead: From emergency leak repairs and boiler servicing to full bathroom installations, we handle every plumbing and gas job with care and expertise.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing
services.desc: Burst pipes, severe leaks, and sudden plumbing failures dealt with fast. We aim to reach Leicester homes within the hour so damage is kept to an absolute minimum.

services.title: Boiler Repair & Servicing
services.desc: Gas Safe registered engineers diagnosing and repairing all major boiler brands. Annual servicing keeps your boiler running safely and efficiently, protecting your warranty.

services.title: Central Heating
services.desc: Full central heating installations, system upgrades, and power flushing to remove sludge and restore heat flow throughout your home. Warmer rooms, lower energy bills.

services.title: Bathroom Installation
services.desc: Full bathroom fit-outs and wet room conversions, including all plumbing, tiling, and finishing. We manage the project from first fix through to a spotless handover.

services.title: Gas Safety Checks
services.desc: Landlord gas safety certificates and domestic gas inspections carried out by our Gas Safe registered engineers. Keep your property compliant and your tenants safe.

services.title: Leak Detection & Repair
services.desc: Pinpointing hidden leaks quickly to prevent structural damage and costly water bills. We repair the source properly rather than offering a temporary fix.

about_pullquote: Every job we take on, we treat it as if it's our own home.
about_para_1: Leicester Plumbing and Gas Services was founded to give homeowners and landlords across Leicester a reliable, honest trade they can actually count on. Based in Wigston, we cover the whole of Leicester and the surrounding areas, bringing Gas Safe registered expertise to every job we take on — big or small.
about_para_2: We've built our reputation the straightforward way: showing up when we say we will, quoting fairly, and finishing every job to a high standard. Our customers return to us time and again because they know there are no hidden charges, no cut corners, and no fuss — just solid plumbing and gas work done properly.
reviews_heading: What Leicester Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Called on a Sunday morning with a burst pipe and they were with us within the hour. Sorted it quickly, explained everything clearly, and the price was very fair. Couldn't recommend highly enough.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Had my boiler serviced and a new thermostat fitted. Really professional from start to finish — punctual, tidy, and no hard sell. Will definitely be using them again for my annual service.
reviews.author: Priya S.

reviews.text: Brilliant service. Spotted a gas issue during a routine check that two other engineers had missed. Gave us a full explanation and fixed it the same day. Genuine peace of mind.
reviews.author: James R.
